item.title: Version 2.0.9
item.description:
Faster, more dependable updates.

  • Updates — downloads come from a faster server, and a download that drops is retried by itself
  • Clearer messages — if an update can’t finish, Notchy says why and what to do, instead of always pointing at your Wi-Fi

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.8
item.description:
A keyboard-driven Files shelf, AirPods listening mode, and smoother motion and feedback across the notch.

  • Files shelf — arrow keys, Return, ⌘C and ⌘V, drag to reorder, and links or text dropped straight onto the shelf
  • AirPods — your listening mode in the AirPods island and on the lock screen, and AirPlay in the Now Playing peek
  • Smoother everywhere — cards and rows press back when clicked, numbers roll as they change, lists fade at their edges, and text is never cut off
  • Minor fixes — swiping a notification away no longer opens the panel, Reply keeps the message it answers, a clicked banner stays closed, and What’s New opens as a compact card

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.7
item.description:
AirDrop and recordings in the notch, iPhone-style Live Activities, Share menu actions, and a redesigned Quick Message.

  • AirDrop — incoming files show a filling ring and the time left in the notch, and Voice Memos recordings show while they run
  • Live Activities — iPhone-style timer and stopwatch rings, rounder message islands and a more compact Now Playing peek
  • Share menu — Copy, Save to Downloads, Save As and Open in Preview from any app's Share button
  • Minor fixes — Notchy opens again on macOS 27.2 betas, a redesigned Quick Message, updates install while your Mac is idle, and Notchy won't run if its app was tampered with after download

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.6
item.description:
Face Unlock that survives updates, steadier desktop widgets on Ventura, and a crash fix.

  • Face Unlock — stays ready after Notchy updates or restarts itself, instead of waiting for Touch ID again
  • Desktop widgets — on macOS Ventura they step aside while Mission Control is open instead of flickering
  • Minor fixes — dragging files onto Notchy no longer crashes it

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.5
item.description:
Live Activities, more useful message actions and Home tools, plus a quieter, more reliable Notchy.

  • Live Activities — timers, downloads and other ongoing updates share the notch more naturally, with an iPhone-inspired look
  • Messages and notifications — open or reply to Teams messages from Notchy, and keep notification banners out of the way
  • Feedback and quick actions — browse feedback and wish-list ideas, use new Dock menu actions, and show symbols with App Intents
  • Minor fixes and refinements — lower idle activity, clearer battery warnings, steadier lock-screen behavior on Ventura, and updates to Terminal, capture tools and glass

All release notes
